Name: Harvest Seeds - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]When harvesting crops there's a chance for it to drop it's seed(s).
It is also possible to define a guaranteed amount that will drop on every harvest.
[/size]

[size=5]Use[/size]
[size=2]Enabled the mod and configure it to your liking.
You can use either the config file or Generic Mod Config Menu for ingame config editing.

[list]
[*][size=2]RegrowableSeeds: true/false (Enables/Disables regrowable plants like Strawberries dropping seeds)
[/size]
[*][size=2]SeedChance: 0-100 (The chance for seeds to drop in percent)[/size]
[*][size=2]MinSeeds: any number (The minimum amount of seeds that will drop)[/size]
[*][size=2]MaxSeeds: any number (The maximum amount of seeds that will drop)[/size]
[*][size=2]GuaranteedSeeds: any number (The guranteed amount of seeds that will drop [b]before[/b] the random seeds are dropping)
[/size]
[/list][/size]

[size=5]Config[/size]
[code]{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "RegrowableSeeds": false,
  "SeedChance": 10,
  "MinSeeds": 1,
  "MaxSeeds": 2,
  "GuaranteedSeeds": 0
}
[/code]

[size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/size]
[*][size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Added separate configurable chances for regrowable crops
